sourceNote: Named people outside the system. memberLinks are the owner's: which alters have a special link to each person.

people.name: Sarah
people.role: The character's parent: a single mother, minister (pastor) of a programmed Friends church in the USA
people.description: Well-meaning but absent, and neglectful to the point of harm: she puts the congregation before raising her child. The game never shows her side.

people.name: Mira Smith
people.role: The prologue's guide: a kind older Friend in Sarah's church
people.description: Tries to be there for Maya as a child, and fails: at 5 she finds Maya forgotten at church; at 8 she raises her worries with Sarah and backs down; by 11 Maya hides how bad things are, and Mira moves away. She falls ill and dies before Maya is 15, and never comes back. Sarah mentions her death in passing in the car.

people.name: Mark
people.role: Ex 1: the Christian ex
people.description: Protestant. A college classmate in Maya's junior year at the University of Illinois. He dates Axel, who starts fronting that year and comes out as a trans man as the body. Mark never learns about the system; it ends when Maya comes back (owner). From Indianapolis.

memberLinks.link: dated Mark, as a trans man

people.name: Adeena
people.role: Ex 2: Maya's girlfriend for two and a half years (Chapter 2). Conservative, later Hasidic; married Michael after they broke up
people.description: 27 when they meet at the museum (she's the registrar). Stern and serious, with a heart of gold. Every Friday she lights the Shabbat candles and Maya covers her eyes with her for the blessing. Her look: the owner designs it.

people.name: Michael
people.role: Adeena's husband, whom she met after the breakup. Maya hears of the wedding in Chapter 6, from an old friend from work.

people.name: Mr. Carter
people.role: A single dad in Sarah's church, present for his children
people.description: The family Maya envies: a single parent like Sarah, but there for his kids. Maya watches them from afar.

people.name: Thomas
people.role: Mr. Carter's son, much older than Maya

people.name: Reneé
people.role: Mr. Carter's daughter, much older than Maya; later, Maya's friend
people.description: Watched from afar in the prologue. As a child she used crutches; as an adult she uses a manual wheelchair. She overheard Mira raising her worries with Sarah (Sunday 2, Maya 8). Years later (chapter 4 or 5) she and adult Maya meet up to talk about being queer and ex-religious: Reneé is an out bisexual and has left Sarah's church, but still identifies as Quaker. She tells Maya what she overheard.

people.name: Rebecca
people.role: Maya's only friend in First Day School
people.description: Kind, but prefers other kids over Maya. Her parents are never named; she calls them "my mom" and "my dad".

people.name: Jamie
people.role: A child in First Day School whom Rebecca prefers

people.role: A child in First Day School whom Rebecca prefers

people.role: The First Day School (Sunday school) teacher

people.role: An elder / board member who keeps Sarah busy

people.role: An elder / board member who keeps Sarah busy

people.name: Miss Susan
people.role: Maya's school teacher (remembered only, never seen)

people.name: Selene
people.role: Maya's classmate at college in Illinois; the first person through whom Maya meets Wicca

people.name: Tanya
people.role: The coven elder (42, they/them): kind but strict. Runs an open, eclectic teaching coven with public sabbat circles; the Prelude's guide
people.description: Stays in Maya's life for the whole game: mostly texts and emails, meeting up less often as time goes by, and a final meeting at the end of the game (owner).

people.name: Gracie
people.role: Chapter 1's guide: a young nun, still in training (25, she/her). Very bright, peppy and excited about her faith, never in a harmful way

people.name: Pastor Key
people.role: Chapter 1.5's guide: the priest at St. Luke's, Mark's queer-friendly Episcopal church. 31, he/him. Kind to Axel, invites him for holidays, not in touch consistently.

people.name: Cassie
people.role: Mark's mother, in Indianapolis: Christmas and Easter at the family's Methodist church.

people.name: Rabbi Abe
people.role: Chapter 2's guide: the rabbi at Adeena's Conservative synagogue. Runs the interfaith couples' meetup (keruv). Vital and refreshing.

people.name: Curator
people.role: The curator at the museum where Maya and Adeena work (placeholder, no name yet).

people.name: Lev

people.name: Rivka

people.name: Savta
people.role: Adeena's grandmother, whose family came from Morocco: Sephardi traditions, the Mimouna (placeholder).

people.name: Dani
